The <b>{{lc:{{PAGENAME}}}}</b> is one of sixteen(16) [[Fishing|fish]] that can be caught, and either processed for [[cooking]] or sold to the [[Lighthouse Keeper]].

==Fishing==
The odds of catching a fish are affected primarily by the other fish in the area at that time.  More competition means your chance of catching a particular fish over another is lowered.  Here is a table of this fish's preferences by the bait used, the place you choose to fish, where you choose to cast, the rod you use, and the time of day.
